name: agentic-website-studio
description: Evidence-first foundation for rights-aware website reference research.

scripts.ensure-local-dirs: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const dir of ['.tmp','.npm-cache']) fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true})"
scripts.studio: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp TMPDIR=.tmp npm_config_cache=.npm-cache tsx src/cli.ts
scripts.test: cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 TEMP=.tmp TMP=.tmp TMPDIR=.tmp npm_config_cache=.npm-cache vitest run --maxWorkers=1
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
